title: Document find-and-replace host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli replace_ passes; pdfxi replace finds literal matches in the run model, rewrites the containing run, saves, reopens and reports initial/replaced/remaining counts on real PDFs; EDIT-003 moves to verified.
notes: Hosts pdfxi_edit::find_replace by mapping matches to single runs and applying pdfxi_edit::replace_run_text, reloading after each edit and re-extracting the saved file.
